powers.text: It dissolves any adhesive it touches, even Sovereign Glue. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: Dissolves any adhesive, even Sovereign Glue.
text: A tube of cloudy white liquid that reeks of alcohol. Use a Utilize action to pour it onto a surface within your reach; on contact it instantly breaks down as much as 1 square foot of glue or other adhesive, Sovereign Glue included.
